questions.question: Are fire extinguishers properly staged around the site - at the stair landing of each floor, within 25'-75' of flammable storage areas, within 100' of any work area, on all mobile equipment?  (Include pictures of at least five fire extinguishers from around site)
Are all fire extinguishers inspected monthly and properly tagged/labelled showing up to date monthly inspections?  (Include at least five pictures of inspection tags from extinguishers around site)
Are all flammable materials properly stored in appropriate locations?
